products.title: Crimson Vineyard Pure Lawn 3-Pece Suit
products.descriptionHtml:
Rich, moody, and undeniably elegant, this solid-toned three-piece set celebrates the natural luster and airy comfort of premium pure lawn. It’s a timeless addition to a seasonal wardrobe, offering a bold pop of color with delicate, artisanal finishing.

The Crimson Vineyard Ensemble is a study in refined minimalism. Drenched in a deep, saturated beet-red hue, the kurta features a subtle textured finish inherent to high-quality lawn. The neckline is thoughtfully detailed with tonal embroidery and a soft notched opening, while the sleeves are finished with a delicate scalloped edge for a feminine touch.

Paired with matching straight-fit lawn trousers, the monochromatic look creates a sleek, elongating silhouette. The centerpiece is the ethereal, tonal dupatta, framed by a striking cream-colored geometric border that provides a crisp, high-contrast finish to the deep crimson base.

Description:

  • Fabric: 100% Breathable Pure Lawn

  • Color: Deep Crimson / Burgundy

  • Detailing: Tonal lace accents on sleeves and neckline; embroidered geometric dupatta border

  • Set Includes: Tunic, Tailored Trousers, and Bordered Dupatta
